name: qkd_pv16_vport_r5-r5-COMMIT
purpose: r5 (Q-VMWB 10-16): the vport is also the V issuer -- the pvw pair's request (pr_*) is demuxed by t[0] onto the landing V get face (vq0/vq1 -> qkd_static_kv_landing_physical_grp VREQ=1) and slot/sel come from a fixed delay (RL 19, WP 2, RT 8 -> 5-edge request wait), so the die needs no calendar producer and no glue; rsp face per side {valid, v, t, 1024-b} (r4); HB1 output pad (r2 native launch 220.23 on one pin) and rst_n pin capture (r1). 0 production cycles.
